The patent office, the company, the patent record and the United Nations: patent DRP 37435. The patent office again: applied for on January 29, 1886, received on November 2, 1886, dated back to the day of application. One witness can be honest and wrong; two or three establish the matter (Deuteronomy 19:15).

car3-others-laboured.close: BACK TO THE QUESTION. Who else built the first car? Cugnot, who made a road vehicle move itself in 1769 and 1770. Frank and Charles Duryea, who built and sold America’s first. Selden owned a paper, not the work. Credit is a debt, so give honour to whom honour is due (Romans 13:7), and give the increase to Yahweh, who supplied every mind and every metal.

car5-the-electric-car-came-early.example: THE PRICE TAG IN ITS OWN DAY. In 1912 a gasoline car cost $650 and an electric roadster $1,750. That same year the electric starter ended the hand crank, the gasoline car’s worst trouble. So a family choosing that year could pay nearly three times as much for an electric, or buy the cheaper car that no longer needed a crank. Read in its own day, the electric did not lose because it was a foolish idea.
car5-the-electric-car-came-early.close: BACK TO THE QUESTION. Was the electric car really new? No. Robert Anderson built a crude electric carriage, William Morrison built a successful American electric car around 1890, and by 1900 electrics made up around a third of the vehicles on the road, because they started instantly and ran clean and quiet. They faded for reasons of their own day: the Model T’s price, the electric starter, better roads and cheap oil. Read the past in its own day and you find what the Word said: "it hath been already of old time" (Ecclesiastes 1:10).
